triples.relationship: promised completion and reported completion of the rebuilt house
triples.rationale: Zechariah promises that the hands which laid the foundation will complete the house. They completed this house by the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

triples.rationale: Zechariah asks whether the people's long-observed fasts were for the Lord. Isaiah likewise challenges self-serving fasting and asks why they fast for Him in such a manner. Both test the religious claim of the fast rather than accepting its outward observance alone.
